pm_exper_user_3676_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: What are some good ways to make sure I don’t lose important documents and photos over the years?
pm_exper_user_3676_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) Since you likely value family keepsakes and cultural heritage, using a secure cloud service for scanned old family photos and documents, along with an external hard drive, can keep them safe. You could set a recurring reminder on your phone to update those backups monthly. Organizing them into date-labeled folders will make it easier to share with relatives later.
(b) A good approach is to use both a cloud storage service and an external hard drive so you have two safe copies of your files. You could set a recurring reminder to update those backups each month. Keeping everything in clearly labeled folders will make them easy to locate years down the line.
(c) Since you already keep digital backups, it’s worth having both a cloud service and an external hard drive, so you’re covered if one fails. You could set a recurring reminder on your phone to update those backups monthly. Organizing files into date-labeled folders will also make it easier to find old pet photos or important documents in the future.
(d) Since you enjoy nature photography, you might back up files to a cloud service that offers high-resolution image storage, alongside an external hard drive for offline safety. You could set a recurring reminder on your phone to update those backups monthly. Organizing files by date and subject will help you store your favorite wildlife shots without losing track of them.
